[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2d[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob gkeep: drain the Google Keep inbox into Obsidian tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob gkeep` moves every Google Keep inbox note into [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`~/bob/gkeep_inbox.md` as Obsidian tasks and archives each note in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Keep only after its current content is provably in the vault. It [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]also shows Keep and the vault side by side in one reconciliation [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]view, and ships `doctor` and `login` so the setup is diagnosable. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The output is styled and consistent with `bob plugins`, and the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tests never touch live Keep.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
